purpose: Desktop modal dropdown/select audit. Shared adapter runtime verification and representative production fixtures are tracked in docs/plans/2026-10-13-desktop-modal-dropdown-audit.md.

method.discovery: Exhaustive Graft JSX literal grep over all apps/web before a complete TypeScript AST scan of all production .tsx consumer files.
method.astScope: apps/web app/features/components consumers; excludes components/ui implementation, tests, stories, DOM fixtures, dot folders and generated artifacts. Resolves named public UI import aliases and detects native select.
method.merge: Three family audits merged, source paths normalized relative to repo and deduplicated by current path + line + primitive. Source comments, empty prerequisites, nested actions and original findings retained in sourceAudits.
method.countUnit: JSX consumer call site, not form count, runtime-mounted instance count, repeated item count or one count per dropdown option.
method.classification: Actual modal/sheet selector sites (including reused modal+inline content), page/inline/global chrome, adjacent calendar/color widgets, selection overlay owners and list contents are separated.
method.runtimeLimit: Source coverage is exhaustive for the listed public/raw JSX contracts. Runtime coverage is shared variants + representative safe fixtures, not a claim that every business form has been clicked with real tenant data.

crosscheck.findings: All discovered consumer selection/anchored/calendar/color controls import public @/components/ui; no native select or private Hero adapter consumer was found.

excluded: Stories/tests fixtures excluded from production count

findings.finding: After choosing RAP material, inventories can remain empty. Trigger currently lacks a specific no-location explanation; submit is safely blocked. Do not fabricate location choices.

positiveFindings: All scoped selection controls use public shared UI; no native raw select, private Hero import or consumer portal overrides found.
RAP manual/none flows preserve explicit empty-string sentinels; all callbacks update draft state.
Project stock location dependency resets on RAP changes and disables until material selected.
RAB edit selectors honor locked estimate permissions with disabled={!editable}.
Onboarding gates missing/failing read data and empty existing-client path separately.
Assignment DialogOptionList provides explicit empty PM copy.
outOfScopeExtraControls: FirstProjectPanel selectors are inline onboarding page controls
CustomColorPicker is inline accordion, not dropdown
DatePickerField expands shared CalendarDialog, included as nested overlay surface

notes: Initial source annotations saying empty normal Select did not open describe the observed pre-fix contract. Final shared empty/disabled-only menu behavior is verified separately by root; historical caller annotations are preserved as evidence rather than unresolved regressions.
Blank value sentinels such as Tidak ditautkan, Tanpa paket, Tanpa vendor are intentionally selectable; they are not zero options.
Create-only lists and custom-value comboboxes remain available with zero existing rows. onChange-driven confirmation and create-action modal handoffs require shared focus/exit coverage.
Calendar and color pickers are adjacent overlay families and excluded from dropdown-only count. SelectionDialog is the owner; DialogOptionList is its content, not a second dropdown trigger.
